name: Commandments The Ten
overview: The Ten Commandments, as spoken and written by God, establish foundational spiritual laws that govern our relationship with Him and others. They begin with the exclusive worship of God, forbidding idolatry and the misuse of His name, and include the call to honor the Sabbath as holy. These commandments reveal God's holiness and justice, showing both His jealousy against sin and His mercy toward those who love and obey Him, ultimately pointing to the spiritual nature of God's law and its fulfillment in Christ.
